description:
Join us for Open Source Friday with Francesco Bonacci, CEO of Cua, exploring the future of computer-use agents.

We discuss Cua’s open-source ecosystem, including Lum, Cua Driver, benchmarks, and the shift from screenshot-based “computer use 1.0” to more capable, policy-driven agents. Francesco shares how his team builds with coding agents, approaches security and evaluation, works with open-source contributors, and stays focused in a rapidly changing AI landscape.
title: Replay: Open Source Friday  Cua with Francesco Bonacci
